title: Moving your books into Celerp
summary: Bring a company over from another accounting system, from upload to the final check.

steps.text: To add a company, open {title}: {fresh} creates an empty company you set up step by step, and {move} brings a company's books over from another accounting system.
For an empty company, enter its {name} and choose {go}.
Under {src}, choose {sys}, upload the export file it gives you and click {analyze}. Nothing is created yet.

Under {cov}, choose how much to bring. Full history recreates every transaction in the file. Cutover starts your books on a date you pick: balances on that date become opening balances, and open invoices, bills and stock are recreated.
Under {map}, choose where each account and setting from your file goes in Celerp. Celerp proposes a match for each one; check them before you go on.
Under {rev}, read the summary of what will be created, then start the import. The new company is created and the records move over.
Under {ver}, Celerp compares its totals with the totals in your file. Review each difference before you finish; you can also fix the file and upload it again.
Once the import starts, a progress page shows each step with what was created, skipped or failed. You can leave the page: the move keeps running.

When it finishes, the results page compares Celerp's totals with your file's, and the company opens from there. A move you no longer want can be discarded from its progress page, which removes the new company and everything imported into it.

You can also ask the assistant to move your books for you: it can read the export files you give it, start the move and take you through the review. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
